note: Local AniList tag shelves for home. A row is shown only when items is not empty. A title is included when an external link's host is crunchyroll.com, www.crunchyroll.com, or beta.crunchyroll.com (http or https) and the path contains /series/{id}, including a Google redirect whose decoded inner URL has that shape. The id is the next path segment. Slug links with no /series/{id} are stored under skipped and are not shown.
